extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 1990s five-door hatchback, approx. 4.1 x 1.8 x 1.5 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.62 m
extras.notes: generic, brand-free 1990s compact hatchback in soft rounded 'bio design': body-colour bumpers with grey rub strips, clear-glass headlights, slim tail light band below the tailgate window, roof spoiler; front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows, seats, rear bench and steering wheel; blank number plates, no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
